definition.title: Print it, Don't Just Think it: 3D Printing and TinkerCAD Workshop for Kids

registrationInfo.onlineInstructions: <p>Participants should bring their own laptop or tablet if possible. The library has a limited number of iPads that can be borrowed for the workshop on a first-come, first-served basis.</p>
registrationInfo.instructionsToAttend: <p>If you can bring your own laptop, please bring it. The branch has a limited number of iPads available.</p>

publishedBefore.title: Print it, Don't Just Think it: 3D Printing and Tinkercad Workshop for Kids
publishedBefore.description: Come join us for an introduction to 3D printing and CAD! We will learn how to use Tinkercad and how 3D printing works. There will be a live demonstration of the 3D printer working. Free. Ages 8-14. Space is limited; no registration is required. This program is generously sponsored by the Friends of the Almaden Library and the SJPL Foundation's Pat Dando Endowment.
publishedBefore.attendanceNote: Free. Ages 8-14. Space is limited, no registration is required.
publishedBefore.blurb: Learn Tinkercad basics and watch a live 3D printer demonstration in this beginner workshop.
